payload.title: Every record carries the site's tenant id from the first deploy
payload.description:
The second site will share this deployment, so the first site's records must already be marked as its own.

```gherkin
Feature: Tenant id from day one

  Scenario: New records are stamped
    Given the deployment has a tenant id for the first site
    When a Story, a Reference and an image are created
    Then each record carries that tenant id
```
